fields.title: Week of Oct 26 – Nov 1
fields.headline: 11 of 14 new hires are on track; Ethan and Daniel are stuck in their first two months.
fields.body:
**On track: 11 of 14.**

**At risk**
- **Daniel Osei** (Account Executive, day 42): territory changed on Oct 20; training restarted.
- **Ethan Cole** (Data Analyst, day 14): no warehouse access, two 1:1s missed.

**Watch**
- **Chloé Martin**: bank details and tax form overdue.

**Changed since last week**
- Noah Kim joined the on-call rotation.

fields.title: Week of Nov 2 – Nov 8
fields.headline: 10 of 16 new hires are on track; 3 are at risk and 2 start within two weeks without everything ready.
fields.body:
**On track: 10 of 16**, down from 11 of 14. Two new starts (Jonas, Aisha) joined the desk.

**At risk**
- **Daniel Osei** — Account Executive, day 50, score 40. Training 50%, three 1:1s missed, pulse 2.6. Action: ramp plan for the Southeast territory by Nov 14.
- **Ethan Cole** — Data Analyst, day 22, score 26. No warehouse access, three 1:1s missed, pulse 2.9. Action: stand-in manager and access — **overdue since Nov 6**.
- **Hana Sato** — Product Designer, starts Nov 23, score 36. Contract not countersigned, no visa letter. Action: by Nov 11.

**Starting within 14 days, not ready**
- **Lucas Ferreira** (Nov 16): no laptop, no Salesforce seat. Action: loaner and seat by Nov 13.
- **Hana Sato** (Nov 23): laptop has no address yet.

**Decisions for Monday**
1. Name a stand-in manager for Ethan today.
2. Approve a loaner laptop for Lucas.
3. Countersign Hana’s contract.
